name: 50_numbers
task: Budget notes dense with spoken numbers, prices, percentages, and dates — all must become figures.

turns.say: Hosting costs went from about twelve hundred dollars a month down to nine hundred eighty dollars.
That's roughly an eighteen percent drop.
Headcount stays at seven until January fifteenth.
And if we close the enterprise deal, revenue should hit one point two million by the end of Q4.

judge.criteria: Every number is a figure ($1,200, $980, 18%, 7, January 15, $1.2M), nothing left in words; concise notes format.
